scripts.dev:full: npm run build:frontend && npm run dev:worker
scripts.typecheck: astro check && tsc --noEmit -p worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node --test tests/contracts.test.ts tests/worker.test.ts tests/frontend.test.ts tests/media.test.ts automation/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:worker
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:publication-intent-v2 && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:backend
